headline: The border booth stops hiding its evidence
lede: Papers, Please-Min's violation inspector now stays on screen after the ink dries: a three-clause deny stays readable while the judged document holds the counter. The stage arrived as another lane's corpse and landed only after a full re-verification on this slot's own server.

notes.text: The pin (#2021): the witness line and its evidence clauses ride about 2.2 seconds past the stamp's ink, the judged papers hold the counter while you read them, and the hearing ends exactly when the next applicant's papers land — or the instant you rule again, so input is never blocked. A clean admit has no case, so nothing pins.

Resumed build: the other builder slot died mid-PR with static green and the branch pushed. The claim script handed #2021 over once its last checkpoint aged past the 90-minute liveness window, and the whole stage was re-run at tip before the merge loop — Node laws, mutant sweep, browser suite, the three lint gates, eslint, build.

Prod proof needs shipping code, not test hooks: the DEV-only harness keys are stripped by the production build, so the check greps the game's lazy route chunk for the live read-window constant. Chunk hashes change every build, and the site redirects asset hosts — without following redirects the 'proof' is just a redirect body.

Numbers: paperscheck 17656/17656 with 42/42 mutants caught (shortening the pin under a 2-second read window turns the law red); papersplay 85/85 with zero page errors, proving stamp ink -> pinned case -> cleared on landing with real key events.
